name: Frontend Development
description: Build modern, accessible, performant user interfaces for the web using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.

name: Backend Development — Node.js & Express
description: Design and build server-side applications, REST APIs, and backend architecture using Node.js and Express.

name: DevOps & Cloud
description: Learn Linux, Git, containerization, CI/CD, and cloud fundamentals to build, deploy, and operate production systems.

name: Relational Databases

name: Data Analytics — Excel, Power BI & Analytics
